result.title: Predicting 3D genome folding from DNA sequence with a convolutional neural network.
result.abstractText:
Background

Hi-C contact maps reveal topologically associating domains and chromatin loops.

Results

We present a deep learning model that predicts contact maps from DNA sequence alone and enables in silico mutagenesis of CTCF sites; it outperforms prior methods on held-out chromosomes.

result.title: Graph neural networks predict enhancer–promoter interactions from Micro-C maps
result.authorString: Chen L, Garcia M, Okafor N.
result.abstractText: Enhancer–promoter interactions shape gene regulation. We develop a graph neural network that uses Micro-C chromatin contacts and epigenomic features to predict enhancer-promoter loops at kilobase resolution.
